create_bucket_sort_task: create a BucketSort task with a custom vocab_size for sorting tokens from a fixed alphabet
sample_batch_sorted_strings: sample a batch of random token strings and their sorted outputs using a JAX PRNG key
get_input_size: get the input size of the BucketSort task which equals the vocab_size
get_output_size: get the output size of the BucketSort task which equals the vocab_size
compute_output_length: compute the output length of the BucketSort task for a given input length
